jobs.title: Elixir Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.desc:
We are a team of twelve in Koblenz, building software for trade businesses along the Rhine and Moselle with Elixir and Phoenix LiveView: scheduling, quotes and invoices, all in real time.

**What you will do**

- Build new features in Elixir and Phoenix LiveView, from the first sketch to deployment
- Look after our PostgreSQL database and make it faster
- Code reviews and pair programming with the team

**What you bring**

- Experience with Elixir, or the wish to learn it properly
- Joy in clean, well-tested code
- Good English for everyday team work

**What to expect**

- Two days a week in the office at the Deutsches Eck, the rest remote
- 30 days of holiday and a €2,000 training budget per year
- A ticket to ElixirConf EU every year
- Pizza at the monthly Elixir meetup
